# Hello World! 👋 Welcome to my academic portfolio and blog! I'm excited to share my journey as a researcher at the intersection of Digital Marketing, AI, and Human Behavior. ## What You'll Find Here This website serves as a comprehensive showcase of my academic and professional work: ### 🔬 Research & Publications - Current research projects involving LLMs and human behavior simulation - Published papers and conference presentations - Collaborations with researchers from KAIST, CMU, and other institutions ### 💻 Technical Projects - AI and Machine Learning implementations - Web development projects - Open source contributions ### 📊 Data & Insights - Analysis of digital marketing trends - Social media behavior studies - Computer vision applications in marketing ## Current Focus I'm currently working on several exciting projects: 1. **PlaceSim Platform**: An LLM-based system for simulating human behavior in physical spaces 2. **AI Content Regulation**: Studying how restrictions affect online community dynamics 3. **CMU Collaboration**: Participating in the AI Intensive Program at Carnegie Mellon ## Why I Love This Work Marketing is fascinating because it touches our daily lives in countless ways. By applying cutting-edge AI technologies to understand consumer behavior, we can create more effective, ethical, and human-centered marketing strategies. The intersection of technology and human psychology offers endless opportunities for discovery and innovation. ## Looking Forward This blog will document my research journey, share insights from conferences and collaborations, and explore the evolving landscape of AI in marketing. I'm always open to discussions, collaborations, and new ideas. Feel free to reach out! --- *Follow my journey through the navigation menu above, and don't hesitate to connect via email or GitHub!* 🚀
